correctness.rationale: A separate reconstruction regenerated the explicit 192 automorphisms, the 200 independent faces and 2,680 flags, and matched all 43 canonical orbit cells with dimension counts (8,17,14,4). The bound from the faithful action on the origin-neighbor six-cycle, using the distinct exterior neighborhood fingerprints, shows these are the full group. Within a closed flag simplex any two orbit-equivalent points have supports with the same set of face cardinalities; those supports must coincide and the action fixes each of their vertices, hence the points agree. Thus closed simplex images are embedded, with their boundaries unions of lower orbit cells; no collapse step depends merely on an inversion-free assertion or on homological cancellation. Independent replay checked each of the 21 codimension-one incidences and unique cofaces, closure after deletion, and the final vertex (index 29). Each pair gives the standard simplex/free-facet deformation retraction glued along the remaining boundary. The independent script and output are at /workspace/branches/5932971c-dce7-458b-b0df-356e0ad0a6b7/independent_audit.py and independent_audit_output.txt in that directory; the frozen script was inspected, not run.
